eyebrow.zh: 川西 · 成都 / 黄龙 / 九寨沟

subtitle.zh: 沿着水的颜色，记下这趟旅程
subtitle.en: Following the colors of the water

intro.zh: 从上海夜航到成都，再坐火车去镇江关。相册里，黄龙的钙华池接着九寨沟的湖和瀑布；有些返程安排还留在当年的行程表里，没有被照片证实。
intro.en: An overnight flight from Shanghai to Chengdu, then a train to Zhenjiangguan. The photos move from Huanglong's terraced pools to Jiuzhaigou's lakes and waterfalls; the notes still leave part of the return route unresolved.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 7 日夜 — 8 月 8 日凌晨

paragraphs.zh: 这趟旅行和李子璐一家同行。行程表写着 20:45 从上海飞往成都双流，落地已经是次日 00:05；第一晚住成都东站附近的如家商旅酒店。相册凌晨一点多的照片里，桌上还有调料和一锅红白分明的汤，城市的第一段记忆先留在了饭桌旁。
paragraphs.en: I traveled with Li Zilu and her family. The itinerary has us flying from Shanghai to Chengdu Shuangliu at 20:45, arriving at 00:05 the next day, with a first-night stay near Chengdu East. The photos taken after 1 a.m. show condiments and a split hotpot: the earliest frames of the trip are at a table.

caption.zh: 凌晨的桌面、砖墙和汤锅，留住抵达后的第一段时间。
caption.en: A late-night table, brick wall and hotpot mark the hours after arrival.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 8 日 · 火车、取车与松潘
subtitle.en: August 8 · train, rental car and Songpan

paragraphs.zh: 出发前在 7 月 25 日买好了车票。行程表从早餐、买零食记起：09:39 的 C6006 从成都东出发，11:02 到镇江关；取车后计划开往免费的松潘古城墙，中午吃牦牛肉汤锅，再往黄龙走。照片里有山间的石碑和坡上的建筑，路程开始变得具体。
paragraphs.en: The train tickets had been bought on July 25. The plan begins with breakfast and snacks, then the 09:39 C6006 from Chengdu East to Zhenjiangguan at 11:02. After picking up a rental car, the plan passes Songpan's free-to-visit old city wall, with yak-beef soup pot for lunch, before continuing toward Huanglong. A stone marker and buildings on the hillside make the journey tangible.

caption.zh: 从镇江关往山里走，镜头开始转向高处的林木。
caption.en: Leaving Zhenjiangguan, the camera turns toward the hillside and trees.

paragraphs.zh: 黄龙安排在下午：行程表提醒 16:00 停止入园，门票、索道和观光车合记 1087。照片先是雾里若隐若现的池子和亭子，后来水色一层层变亮。沿着山坡看过去，钙华台地比一张俯瞰照片更有层次。
paragraphs.en: Huanglong was planned for the afternoon, with a 16:00 last-admission reminder and 1087 recorded for admission, cableway and sightseeing bus together. The first frames show pools and a pavilion half-hidden by mist; later the water brightens terrace by terrace. Seen along the hillside, the travertine pools reveal more layers than one panorama can hold.

caption.zh: 雾和钙华池交错，远景与脚边的水流轮流出现。
caption.en: Mist, terraces and close views of running water alternate along the path.

paragraphs.zh: 走到后面，树林、浅池与水道不断换位置；同一片山色里，水有时偏浅蓝，有时透着青绿。把这些相近的照片放在一起，才看得出脚步是怎样沿着池边慢慢往前的。
paragraphs.en: Further on, trees, shallow pools and streams trade places in the frame. Against the same mountains, the water shifts between pale blue and green. Keeping these closely related photographs together lets the walk along the pools unfold at its own pace.

caption.zh: 傍晚前，镜头停在林间的水与缓坡上。
caption.en: Before evening, the camera lingers on water and gentle wooded slopes.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 8 日 · 前往九寨沟

paragraphs.zh: 计划里，从黄龙机场一带开往九寨沟千古风情，20:30 看演出，门票记了 800；之后住九寨沟景区店的如家商旅酒店，住宿记了 932。照片里有一张舞台合影，但它没有拍摄时间，不能只凭这张图确认整段晚间安排。晚些时候拍到的汤锅和甜点，倒是把赶路后的夜晚留了下来。
paragraphs.en: The plan continues from the Huanglong Airport area toward the Jiuzhaigou Eternal Love show at 20:30, with 800 noted for tickets, then to the Home Inn near the scenic area, with 932 listed for lodging. A stage photo has no capture timestamp, so it cannot confirm the whole evening on its own. Later photographs of hotpot and dessert do record a meal after the day's travel.

caption.zh: 一张没有拍摄时间的舞台照片。
caption.en: A stage photograph without a capture timestamp.

caption.zh: 22 点后的餐桌，留住了这一天的尾声。
caption.en: A table photographed after 10 p.m. closes the day.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 9 日 · 九寨沟第一天

paragraphs.zh: 行程表给九寨沟留了整天：先坐观光车到诺日朗游客中心，去原始森林走三公里，再从天鹅海上车、箭竹海下车。照片从林间小路开始，随后湖面一会儿像淡绿的玻璃，一会儿映着山影。沿着水边走，比照着景点名单赶路更能看出它不断变化的颜色。
paragraphs.en: The itinerary sets aside a full day: sightseeing bus to Nuorilang visitor center, a three-kilometer walk through the primeval forest, then a bus from Swan Lake to Arrow Bamboo Lake. The photos start on woodland paths and move to lakes that look pale green in one frame and mirror the mountains in the next. Along the water's edge, the changing color is easier to follow than a checklist of stops.

caption.zh: 树林与湖岸交替出现，途中也留下一张自拍。
caption.en: Woodland and lakeshore alternate, with a portrait along the way.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 9 日 · 步行与乘车之间
subtitle.en: August 9 · between walks and shuttle rides

paragraphs.zh: 行程表接着写熊猫海、五花海、珍珠滩瀑布，再坐车去镜海和诺日朗瀑布。相册里，有林间的层叠瀑布，也有几乎静止的蓝绿色湖面；景点的精确对应不必从每张相近的水景里猜出来。快水和静水挨在一起看，反而像这一天最清楚的节奏。
paragraphs.en: The notes continue through Panda Lake, Five Flower Lake and Pearl Shoal Waterfall, then a bus to Mirror Lake and Nuorilang Waterfall. The album has tiered falls among trees and almost still blue-green water; it is better not to guess a precise attraction for every similar view. Seen together, moving and quiet water give this day its clearest rhythm.

caption.zh: 瀑布之后又回到湖边，山影逐渐展开。
caption.en: After the falls, the path returns to the lakes and widening mountain reflections.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 9 日 · 沿着湖边继续走

paragraphs.zh: 湖水在镜头里一层层加深，倒木、树枝和云影把每一片蓝绿切成不同的形状。行程表还记了老虎海、树正瀑布和一连串海子；照片不替它们逐一认名，只把一路上真正看见的山林和水保留下来。
paragraphs.en: The water deepens through the photographs. Fallen trunks, branches and cloud reflections divide each shade of blue and green into a different shape. The plan also lists Tiger Lake, Shuzheng Waterfall and many more lakes. Rather than assigning every picture a name, these frames keep the mountains, trees and water as we saw them.

caption.zh: 从浓蓝的湖到湍急的溪，颜色一直没有停下来。
caption.en: From deep-blue water to a rushing stream, the color never stays still.

paragraphs.zh: 往后，水声又占了上风：有宽阔的瀑布，也有从树林边流过的急水。接着视线重新被远处的山和湖拉开。将瀑布和湖面放在相邻的几组照片里，比只挑一张代表九寨沟，更像那天走路的记忆。
paragraphs.en: Later the sound of water seems to take over again: broad falls, then fast water beside the trees. The view opens back out toward mountains and lakes. Keeping the waterfalls beside the quieter water feels closer to the memory of walking through the valley than choosing one image to stand for it all.

caption.zh: 宽瀑、山影和湖水，镜头从近处重新走向远处。
caption.en: Broad falls, mountain reflections and lake water lead the eye outward again.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 9 日 · 一天的收尾
subtitle.en: August 9 · the end of a long day

paragraphs.zh: 接近傍晚，镜头还在蓝色湖边，之后出现了观光车、木制房间里的陈设和餐桌。行程表把当天景区项目记为 1102，晚餐记为 735；住处写着沟里的云漫山居。照片里还有两人坐在水边的背影，为这段长长的路留了一个安静的句号。
paragraphs.en: Near evening, the camera is still beside blue water; later frames show a sightseeing bus, the interior of a wooden room and dinner. The notes list 1102 for the day's scenic-area entry without further breakdown, 735 for dinner, and a stay at Yunman Shanju inside the valley. A silhouette of two people by the water gives the long walk a quiet ending.

caption.zh: 景区里的最后几幅，与晚上餐桌的照片相连。
caption.en: The final scenic-area frames lead into the evening meal.

caption.zh: 两张不同的湖边背影，不用为它们猜一个拍摄地点。
caption.en: Two different lakeside silhouettes, without guessing an exact shooting spot.

title.en: One More Morning by the Water

subtitle.zh: 8 月 10 日 · 九寨沟第二天

paragraphs.zh: 第二天的计划是往长海方向去，走一公里看五彩池，再坐区间车回诺日朗。相册里，早上八点多先拍到大片瀑布，九点后是雾里的湖面，十点又回到溪流与蓝绿色的水。它们能确认这一天还在景区看水，却不足以逐一坐实每个景点的名字。
paragraphs.en: The second-day plan heads toward Long Lake, with a one-kilometer walk to Five-Color Pond and a shuttle back to Nuorilang. The dated album begins with broad waterfalls after 8 a.m., misty lake views after 9 and more streams and blue-green water at 10. It confirms another morning by the water, though not the exact name of each photographed stop.

caption.zh: 先是瀑布，接着是有雾的湖面。
caption.en: First the waterfalls, then a lake in the mist.

paragraphs.zh: 到十点左右，湖边的树、石头间的溪流和远处的山又换了几次位置。照片里没有刻意把某一处水色当作终点；一路继续看下去，蓝绿还在变。
paragraphs.en: Around ten, trees by the lake, water between rocks and distant mountains change places in the frame again. No single patch of blue-green is treated as the finish line; the color keeps shifting as the walk continues.

caption.zh: 最后一段湖岸与溪流的照片。
caption.en: The last run of lakeshore and stream photographs.

subtitle.zh: 8 月 10 日 · 走出景区之后

paragraphs.zh: 下午的相册里是窗边两杯饮品，傍晚则出现蓝天下的街道、建筑和路边风车。另有一张与同行家人在山间的合照，没有拍摄时间；它留在这段旅程里，却不能用来补写某个确定的停留点。
paragraphs.en: The afternoon album has two drinks by a window; by evening there are streets, buildings and a roadside pinwheel under blue sky. An undated group portrait with the family also belongs to this trip, but cannot establish a particular stop or time.

caption.zh: 下午的饮品和傍晚街景，照片在这里停下。
caption.en: Afternoon drinks and evening streets are where the dated photographs end.

caption.zh: 与同行家人的合影，具体拍摄时间未记下。
caption.en: A portrait with our companions; its exact time is not recorded.

title.en: The return route still needs checking

body.zh: 旧行程表在 8 月 10 日同时写了牟尼沟、镇江关还车、回成都东的火车和黄龙飞杭州的航班，时间互相重叠。相册只记录到这天傍晚；8 月 11—12 日也没有另外的游记材料，因此这里不替当年的自己选一条未证实的返程路线。
body.en: The old itinerary places Mounigou, returning the car at Zhenjiangguan, a train to Chengdu East and a flight from Huanglong to Hangzhou on the same overlapping afternoon and evening. The dated photographs end that evening; there are no separate notes for August 11–12. I cannot establish which return route actually happened.

subtitle.zh: 行程表上的费用，未核对实际支付

paragraphs.zh: 行程表留下了下面这些数字。有的写明了项目，有的只写了数额；它们未必都是最终支付，也不把互相冲突的返程交通合算成一笔旅行总额。
paragraphs.en: These numbers come from the itinerary. Some have named purposes and others only an amount; they are not necessarily final payments. The conflicting return options should not be rolled into a single trip total.

label.zh: 8 月 9 日景区项目（未细分）
镇江关 → 成都东（待核对）

title.en: The Colors Stay in the Album
